title: The Kitten in the Basket
skill_description: Practice reading two-syllable words with closed syllables divided between consonants (VC/CV pattern): kitten, rabbit, hidden, sudden, basket.
author: FunBookies
summary: A kitten named Mittens makes an unexpected friend when a rabbit hops through the window. They discover that sudden surprises can lead to wonderful friendships.

parent_tips.before_reading: Look at the cover together. Ask: What animals do you see? Where might they be hiding?
parent_tips.during_reading: Help your child clap out two-syllable words: kit-ten, rab-bit, bas-ket. Point out the double consonants in the middle.
parent_tips.after_reading: Ask: How did Mittens feel when she first saw the rabbit? How did her feelings change?

comprehension_questions.question: Where was Mittens hiding at the start of the story?
How did the rabbit get into the house?
What made the rabbit hop into the basket?
comprehension_questions.answer: A puppy barked and scared the rabbit

comprehension_questions.question: What lesson did Mittens learn?
comprehension_questions.answer: That sudden surprises can bring wonderful new friends

pages.text: The Kitten in the Basket
pages.scene: A fluffy orange kitten and a brown rabbit peeking out from a woven basket together. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text: Words to Know
A little kitten named Mittens was hidden inside a big basket.
pages.scene: A fluffy orange kitten peeking out from a woven basket in a sunny room. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text: Mittens was a happy kitten who loved to run and play all day.
pages.scene: The playful kitten bounding through a living room, toys scattered around. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text: One day, something funny happened in the kitchen near the ladder.
pages.scene: The kitchen with a wooden ladder against the wall, kitten looking curious. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text: A rabbit hopped in through the open window and landed on the rug.
pages.scene: A brown rabbit mid-hop, coming through an open kitchen window. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text: Mittens had never seen a rabbit before and felt a sudden surprise.
pages.scene: The kitten with wide eyes, fur slightly raised, staring at the rabbit. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text: The rabbit looked at the kitten and began to nibble on a carrot.
pages.scene: The rabbit calmly eating a carrot while the kitten watches intently. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text: Mittens thought the rabbit was silly but also pretty and fluffy.
pages.scene: The kitten tilting its head, studying the soft fluffy rabbit. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text: The kitten crept closer and sniffed the rabbit with her little button nose.
pages.scene: The kitten cautiously approaching, nose twitching near the rabbit. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text: The rabbit did not run away but just kept on munching dinner.
pages.scene: The relaxed rabbit continuing to eat, kitten sitting nearby watching. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text: Mittens felt happy that the rabbit was not hidden from her at all.
pages.scene: The kitten looking pleased, sitting companionably next to the rabbit. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text: They sat together on the rug and looked out the window at sunset.
pages.scene: Kitten and rabbit sitting side by side, golden sunset light streaming in. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text: A puppy ran past the window and barked at a passing jogger.
pages.scene: View through window of a puppy chasing after someone jogging by. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text: The sudden noise made the rabbit hop into the basket in a hurry.
pages.scene: The startled rabbit leaping into the woven basket beside the kitten. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text: Mittens followed the rabbit and snuggled into the basket with her new buddy.
pages.scene: Both animals curled up together cozily in the basket. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text: The kitten purred and the rabbit felt better in the hidden spot.
pages.scene: The kitten purring contentedly, rabbit's nose twitching peacefully. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text: Nothing could bother them when they were hidden in the basket.
pages.scene: The basket with both animals inside, looking safe and warm. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text: When dinner time came, the children put food in two little dishes.
pages.scene: Children placing food bowls near the basket, animals perking up. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text: Mittens ate her kitten food and the rabbit ate fresh lettuce.
pages.scene: Both animals eating from their respective bowls side by side. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text: After dinner, they went back to the basket and fell asleep together.
pages.scene: The kitten and rabbit curled up sleeping peacefully in the basket. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text: From that day on, the kitten and the rabbit were the best of buddies.
pages.scene: The kitten and rabbit playing together in a sunny garden, both happy. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text: Mittens learned that sudden surprises can bring wonderful new buddies.
pages.scene: The kitten and rabbit nuzzling each other affectionately. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text: And the little basket became their hidden spot in the whole house.
pages.scene: The cozy basket with both animals inside, surrounded by soft blankets, warm light. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text: The End
pages.scene: Kitten and rabbit sleeping peacefully in the basket under moonlight. Warm watercolor style.
